name: artworkguard
description: Packaging artwork comparison and verification platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/check-licences.mjs
